title: Heat Action Plan for Palanpur City 2025 - Palanpur, India
organization: Gujarat State Disaster Management Authority; Palanpur Municipality; Council on Energy, Environment and Water (GSDMA; CEEW)
landscapes: Arid, Urban, Household, Institutional, Occupational, Mass Gatherings, Tropical and Subtropical
description: This city-level heat action plan for Palanpur, Gujarat uses on-ground socio-economic data, historical climate datasets, future climate projections, satellite-derived indices, and ward-level heat-risk mapping to guide heat preparedness, response, and long-term mitigation. It includes local heat-health thresholds, early warning, inter-agency coordination, health sector preparedness, public communication, occupational protections, community cooling systems, water access, urban greening, monitoring and evaluation, and heat-related morbidity and mortality surveillance.
